We'll write tests using assertions from org.junit.Assert.*. Use parameterized? Not needed.

Edge cases: null inputs, invalid strings length, invalid case, missing underscores, variant only, etc.

Test toLocale: valid strings "en", "en_GB", "en_GB_xxx". Also variant where country missing but variant present: "en__POSIX"? Actually code: if ch3 == '_' (i.e., third char after underscore) then treat as language + "" + variant. Example "en__POSIX"? Let's check: str length >=5? For len >5? Actually after language (2) '_' at index2, then ch3 at index3. If ch3 == '_' then return new Locale(str.substring(0,2), "", str.substring(4)). So string like "en__POSIX" where index3 '_' and variant starts at index4. That's allowed. Test that.

Invalid strings: null returns null; "e" (len1) throws IllegalArgumentException; "EN" (uppercase) throws; "en-gb" (dash) throws; "en_G" (len4) throws; "en_GB_" (len6, missing variant) throws; "en_GB_x" (len7 but variant single char? allowed? It will go to final return new Locale(..., str.substring(6)). That's fine; but variant can be anything. Not needed.

Test localeLookupList: when locale null returns empty list. When locale has variant and country: e.g., new Locale("fr","CA","xxx") expecting list of locale, language+country, language only, default (if not already present). For default same as locale, should not duplicate.

Test localeLookupList with default separate: locale fr_CA_xxx default en_US. Expect list includes locale, language+country, language only, default (if not already). Ensure unmodifiable: attempt to modify list throws UnsupportedOperationException.

Test languagesByCountry: Provide known country code e.g., "US". Ensure list contains locales with country US and no variant. Could check that each locale's country equals "US" and variant empty. Also test null returns empty list. Also test caching: call method twice and ensure same instance (==). Might use assertSame.

Test countriesByLanguage: similar for language "en". Ensure each locale's language equals "en", country non-empty, variant empty. Null returns empty list. Caching test with assertSame.

Test availableLocaleList/set: ensure they are unmodifiable, contain same elements as Locale.getAvailableLocales(). Ensure list size matches set size.

Test isAvailableLocale: check true for known locale, false for unknown (new Locale("xx","YY")).

Potential concurrency maps: Not needed.

Write test class named LocaleUtilsTest in same package org.apache.commons.lang3.

Will need to import java.util.*.

Add @RunWith(JUnit4) optional.

Implement helper method to compare lists.
